pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular sub-polygonal dark regions with high-contrast boundaries. Edge gradients are sharp along the dorsal-lateral transition. Spatial area of dark patches is significantly greater than the surrounding light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored pathways forming a dense topological grid. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the neck and upper flank regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the mane line from the upper neck to the shoulder junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark-colored avian organism perched on the dorsal-lateral ridge at the base of the neck/shoulder interface.
